---
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

# Documentation instructions

- Use descriptive headings, short paragraphs, CommonMark tables, and compact Mermaid diagrams.
- Keep one authoritative home for each rule; link from summaries rather than copy long sections.
- Preserve stable requirement, hypothesis, evidence, ADR, threat, and experiment identifiers.
- Keep claims close to citations. Label evidence class, scope, date, scale, and limitations.
- Treat unresolved items as explicit questions or Proposed decisions; avoid placeholder-only files.
- Update incoming and outgoing relative links when moving or renaming documents.
